plan: A marksman who is fragile early but becomes unstoppable after her first takedown in a fight.
aSurveiller: Her passive (Get Excited!). After each takedown she runs and shoots much faster: don't give her the first kill of a fight.
contrer: Engage her in melee range: she has no escape.
Avoid her traps on the ground (E): they root you.
Focus her first: once she gets going, she is very hard to stop.
forces: Huge damage in the late game.
Her R crosses the map to finish off a wounded target.

sorts.P: Huge speed after a takedown or a destroyed turret.
sorts.Q: Swaps weapon: fast minigun or rockets that hit an area.
sorts.W: Beam that damages, slows and reveals.
sorts.E: Traps on the ground that root.
sorts.R: Rocket that crosses the map, stronger on wounded targets.

momentFort: Weak early, very strong in the late game with her items.
